info.title: Aether DV engine API
info.description: Local API between aetherd (engine) and UIs. Transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket on 127.0.0.1 (token in a 0600 file) or a Unix socket / Windows named pipe. Events are JSON-RPC notifications with method 'event' and params {cursor, topic, data}. Phase B draft; additive changes bump minor, breaking changes bump major.
